power_architecture_decision.adopted: power.md §7 — single change: delete AMS1117-3.3 and the 5V->3V3 linear path; generate 3V3 directly from the protected 12V rail with an on-board LM2596S-3.3 switcher; demote the Mini-360 to feeding only the C3 SuperMini 5V pin.
power_architecture_decision.rejected_original: ARCHITECTURE-V2 CR-06 two-stage tree Mini-360(12->5) -> AMS1117-3.3(5->3.3).
power_architecture_decision.reason: AMS1117 dissipates 1.10 W in SOT-223 at the 646 mA 3V3 peak -> Tj 138 C at 70 C automotive ambient (Tjmax 125 C), and it forces the Mini-360 to carry ~1.00 A, past its measured ~750 mA trip point. Both failures vanish when the 3V3 rail is switched from 12 V.
power_architecture_decision.why_not_one_3A_buck_to_3V3_for_everythin: The C3 SuperMini's 3V3 pin is its own LDO output; driving it externally while USB is attached creates a second contention path. Keeping the C3 on 5 V preserves exactly one backfeed path (the documented USB maintenance path), already handled by D3.

SMD 1812 adopted over netlist.md's radial THT alternative — hand-solderable and keeps the input loop tight. 16 V rating is fine downstream of TVS1.
